name: Young Lovers
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details:
Oh, I'm cursed!  My heart belongs to Tommy Joe Stonefield, but our families are bitter enemies.  So I can't see him, even though my eyes ache to gaze upon that handsome face!

Please, take this letter and give it to Tommy Joe.  He's usually at the river to the west of the Stonefield Farm, which is due west of here.
narrative.objectives: Give Maybell's Love Letter to Tommy Joe Stonefield.
narrative.offerRewardText: Ah! I can't stand us being apart. I have to see her!!
narrative.requestItemsText: You have what?? Maybell is the light of my dull life. Hurry, let me see her letter!
